findings.title: Sector drill-down window with 'Open all industries': columns are cut at the window's right edge and both tables scroll sideways
findings.where: Relative strength / Sector drill-down window, 1440, 1280 and 1152 widths, light
findings.steps: Open Relative strength, expand Sector drill-down, press 'Open all industries'. Read the right edge of both tables (without industries open nothing is cut and nothing scrolls).
findings.expected: User (EXEC.md 2026-11-27, 'A'): every column edge of the stocks table on a column edge of the sector table and nothing cut, with and without 'Open all industries'.
findings.actual: Edges do line up (stocks table 8 columns, 0 edges off the sector table's). But the tables need 1062 px in a 1012 px scroller: the first view shows 'Mon' / 'Fad' / 'Gai' (Momentum column) and 'Weig' / 'Rp 30.0E' (Weight column) cut at the edge; one has to scroll sideways (edge-fade cue exists). The stacked window is capped at 1040 px wide (windows.ts:40 `stacked ? 1040`) while the 13-column table with the wider first column needs about 50 px more. tests/look/round2.mjs step 7 passes because it only counts ellipsis cuts.
findings.evidence: shots/rsD_win_1440_true.png; probe p5.mjs: 'hscroll tbl-wrap xs-r xs-b:1062/1012 fw-tw:1062/1012' at 1440, 1280 and 1152 with industries open; none with industries closed.

findings.title: At a 1152 screen the seven 'side by side' windows are stacked, so chart height cannot follow the table
findings.where: Overview and Relative strength windows (Momentum, Sector x horizon, Cumulative return, Relative return, Rank change, Weekly excess return, stock lines), viewport 1096 (1152 screen)
findings.steps: Viewport 1096 x 800, open any of the seven windows.
findings.expected: The user named 1152 among the widths for the level-ending windows.
findings.actual: windows.ts:32 `narrow = innerWidth < 1100` stacks the window (class stk): chart on top, table below, table pane scrolls (right pane bottom 1138 vs window bottom 776). 1440 and 1280 are side by side and end level within 11 px (table last row 708 vs pane 719). Pre-existing rule, 4 px below the threshold; report as a question whether the threshold should drop to 1096.
